vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit (e.g. https://beads.gardenio.e2e.example.com or http://localhost:8095). The harness will hit canonical pages off this base.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (date stamp or short slug) used as the output directory name under docs/info-density/<ITERATION>/. Used so multiple pours don't collide.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (ka-0000005684). All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here so the operator can browse one tree.

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): warm up {{TARGET_URL}} and verify canonical pages
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup

Confirm the audit target is reachable and every canonical page returns
< 400 before we burn cycles capturing/measuring.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

`{{TARGET_URL}}` is expected to be `http://localhost:8095` (see schedule
`ka-0000002369`, advice `ka-0000006483`, and
`gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md`). The agent pod has no public
route to the viewer; it port-forwards to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` in
its own namespace and authenticates with a Keycloak `client_credentials`
bearer minted from the operator-managed Secret the agent ServiceAccount can
read.

```bash
# Namespace + helm release. Both default to "gardenio" in the gardenio
# namespace, where the audit pod is scheduled.
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}

# Mint a viewer-audience bearer (lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh —
# ka-0000006483). NOT mint_user_token / the user-grant path (wrong here).
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }

# Bootstrap captor operator row via the daemon. Without this, /inbox renders
# the unprovisioned-operator banner and the audit captures the mode_a empty
# stream instead of real content (ka-0000004196). Mirrors the inline block
# .rwx/info-density-audit.yml runs against svc/gardenio-rwx-beads.
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 \
  > /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
BEADS_PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 1 "http://localhost:8080/healthz" 2>/dev/null && break
  sleep 0.5
  if [ "$i" = "60" ]; then
    echo 'BLOCKED: beads daemon port-forward not healthy within 30s'
    cat /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
done
LINK_HTTP=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/bootstrap-resp.json -w '%{http_code}' \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-info-density-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  "http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases")
if [ "$LINK_HTTP" != "200" ]; then
  echo "BLOCKED: operator bootstrap failed (HTTP $LINK_HTTP)"
  cat /tmp/bootstrap-resp.json >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi

# Tunnel to the in-cluster ClusterIP. Background it; tear down on exit.
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 \
  > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
# Wait for :8095 to bind (poll instead of sleeping — fail loud after 30s).
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
    "http://localhost:8095/health" && break
  sleep 1
done
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware).
With it, the viewer's `extractToken()` accepts the `Authorization` header
directly — no cookie / forwardauth dance required.

### Steps

1. From `~/bot/gardenio/work`, ensure repo is fresh:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   ```

2. Set up the tunnel + bearer per the prereq block above. After that
   `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" http://localhost:8095/health`
   must return 200.

3. Discover canonical pages from the source of truth:
   ```bash
   grep -E "capture\(page, viewport, '" \
     gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tests/canonical-pages.spec.js \
     | sed -E "s/.*capture\(page, viewport, '([^']+)', .*/\1/" | sort -u
   ```
   Expected (current snapshot): `advice agents agents-filtered bead-show
   costs health index project search` (9 pages). If list drifts, capture
   the new set in your comment — DO NOT hand-maintain a parallel list.

4. For each page, hit `{{TARGET_URL}}` + the page path (paths in the
   spec file) with the bearer attached. All 9 must be < 400.
   ```bash
   for spec in 'index:/' 'project:/p/gardenio' 'bead-show:/ka-0000002478' \
               'search:/search?q=screenshot' 'agents:/agents' \
               'agents-filtered:/agents?project=gardenio' 'advice:/advice' \
               'health:/health' 'costs:/costs'; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
       -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
       "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}")
     printf '%-18s %-44s -> %s\n' "$slug" "$path" "$code"
   done
   ```

### Deliverables (post all as comments on this bead, then close it)

- Comment: list of canonical pages discovered (one per line)
- Comment: per-page HTTP status table
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-page failure detail

If any page returns ≥ 400, do NOT close — file a bug bead parented to
{{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK this step (comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). The
downstream steps depend on a clean baseline.

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM dumps for each canonical page
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture

Run the Playwright screenshot harness against `{{TARGET_URL}}` and store
output deterministically under `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`.
The Playwright config (`gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/playwright.config.js`)
already injects `Authorization: Bearer $BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER` as an
`extraHTTPHeader` when that env var is set — so the harness will Just Work
against the localhost tunnel as long as the bearer is exported.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

`{{TARGET_URL}}` is expected to be `http://localhost:8095` (see schedule
`ka-0000002369`, advice `ka-0000006483`, and
`gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md`). The agent pod has no public
route to the viewer; it port-forwards to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` in
its own namespace and authenticates with a Keycloak `client_credentials`
bearer minted from the operator-managed Secret the agent ServiceAccount can
read.

```bash
# Namespace + helm release. Both default to "gardenio" in the gardenio
# namespace, where the audit pod is scheduled.
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}

# Mint a viewer-audience bearer (lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh —
# ka-0000006483). NOT mint_user_token / the user-grant path (wrong here).
# shellcheck disable=SC1091

# Bootstrap captor operator row via the daemon. Without this, /inbox renders
# the unprovisioned-operator banner and the audit captures the mode_a empty
# stream instead of real content (ka-0000004196). Mirrors the inline block
# .rwx/info-density-audit.yml runs against svc/gardenio-rwx-beads.
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 \

trap 'kill $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 1 "http://localhost:8080/healthz" 2>/dev/null && break
  sleep 0.5
  if [ "$i" = "60" ]; then
    echo 'BLOCKED: beads daemon port-forward not healthy within 30s'
    cat /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
done
LINK_HTTP=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/bootstrap-resp.json -w '%{http_code}' \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-info-density-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  "http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases")
if [ "$LINK_HTTP" != "200" ]; then
  echo "BLOCKED: operator bootstrap failed (HTTP $LINK_HTTP)"
  cat /tmp/bootstrap-resp.json >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi

# Tunnel to the in-cluster ClusterIP. Background it; tear down on exit.
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 \
  > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
# Wait for :8095 to bind (poll instead of sleeping — fail loud after 30s).
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
    "http://localhost:8095/health" && break
  sleep 1
done
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware).
With it, the viewer's `extractToken()` accepts the `Authorization` header
directly — no cookie / forwardauth dance required.

### Steps

1. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/info-density/{{ITERATION}}
   ```

2. Set up the tunnel + bearer per the prereq block above (if you didn't
   already in step 1). Export the bearer under the name the Playwright
   config reads:
   ```bash
   export BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER=$VIEWER_BEARER
   ```

3. Run the screenshot harness:
   ```bash
   BEADS_VIEWER_URL='{{TARGET_URL}}' make screenshot-beads-viewer
   ```
   Output lands under `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/{desktop,narrow}/<page>.png`.

4. Also dump rendered HTML for each canonical page (so the measure step
   has real DOM to weigh) — bearer is mandatory:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html
   for slug in advice agents agents-filtered bead-show costs health index project search; do
     case "$slug" in
       index) path='/' ;;
       project) path='/p/gardenio' ;;
       bead-show) path='/ka-0000002478' ;;
       search) path='/search?q=screenshot' ;;
       agents-filtered) path='/agents?project=gardenio' ;;
       *) path="/$slug" ;;
     esac
     curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
       "{{TARGET_URL}}$path" \
       -o "docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html"
   done
   ```

5. Move screenshots into the run directory:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots
   cp -r gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/* \
     docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/
   ```

6. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(info-density): capture {{ITERATION}} for {{TARGET_URL}}"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch pushed (or kept local for now): `chore/info-density/{{ITERATION}}`
- `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/{html,screenshots}/` populated
- Comment: `du -sh` of the captures dir + page count + commit SHA

If the harness fails, root-cause it (don't paper over) — comment with the
failure and BLOCK. Common cause: the kubectl port-forward died (check
`/tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log`) or the bearer expired mid-run (re-mint and
retry).

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): compute objective info-density metrics per page
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure

Walk the captures from step 2 and compute an objective info-density vector per page. No subjective judgement here — the next step does that.

### Per-page metrics

For each `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/<slug>.html`:

| Metric | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `dom_element_count` | `grep -oE '<[a-zA-Z][^>]*>' file.html | wc -l` |
| `text_byte_count` | strip tags via `python3 -c "import re,sys; print(len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',open(sys.argv[1]).read())))" file.html` |
| `text_byte_per_dom` | `text_byte_count / dom_element_count` (Python float) |
| `unique_links` | `grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' file.html | sort -u | wc -l` |
| `data_fields` | count of `<td>`, `<dd>`, `<li>` and `<dt>` elements (rough proxy for distinct data points) |

For each `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/<slug>.png` (and `narrow`):

| Metric | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `pixel_count` | image width × height |
| `near_white_ratio` | fraction of pixels with R, G, B all ≥ 240 (use Python + Pillow: `pip install --quiet Pillow` then iterate). 1.0 = blank. Lower = denser. |
| `mean_luma` | mean luminance (sanity check: pure-white page = ~1.0). |

Write a Python helper at `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-density.py` that ingests the captures dir and emits one JSON per page plus a roll-up `metrics.json`. Commit the helper.

### Output

```
docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json
```

Shape:
```json
{
  "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}",
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "pages": {
    "index": {
      "html": {"dom_element_count": 1234, "text_byte_count": 5678, "text_byte_per_dom": 4.6, "unique_links": 89, "data_fields": 42},
      "desktop": {"pixel_count": 1024000, "near_white_ratio": 0.31, "mean_luma": 0.78},
      "narrow":  {"pixel_count":  384000, "near_white_ratio": 0.28, "mean_luma": 0.79}
    },
    ...
  }
}
```

### Deliverables
- Commit the helper script and `metrics.json` on the branch `chore/info-density/{{ITERATION}}`.
- Comment with a summary table (page, DOM elems, near-white desktop, near-white narrow).
- If any page screenshot is unreadable / capture failed, mark it `null` in the JSON and comment a warning — do not BLOCK; downstream judge will skip nulls.

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): qualitative verdicts per page
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge

Produce a per-page verdict combining the objective metrics from step 3 with a qualitative review of each screenshot.

### Threshold heuristics (apply first; cheap)

A page is **suspect-sparse** if any of these hold on desktop viewport:
- `near_white_ratio` ≥ 0.55 (more than half the pixels are blank)
- `data_fields` ≤ 20
- `dom_element_count` ≤ 300
- `text_byte_per_dom` ≤ 1.5 (DOM is structure-heavy with little content)

A page is **definitely-sparse** if two or more thresholds trip.

### Qualitative review (slower; for every page)

For each captured screenshot at desktop viewport, *visually inspect* the image (use the Read tool on the PNG if you are an agent that supports image reading, or reason from the metrics + HTML if not) and answer:

1. What's actually visible above the fold? (list distinct datum types)
2. What's missing that would belong on this screen? Examples per page:
   - **index**: should show recent activity, hot beads, agent count, MR status
   - **project**: should show counts by status, recent beads, top owners, blocked work
   - **bead-show**: should show comments, deps, activity, mentions, links
   - **search**: results table with title, type, status, owner, age
   - **agents**: agent list with project, role, last_run, status
   - **costs**: costs by project, by agent, by day
   - **advice**: advice list with project, role, label scope
   - **health**: per-component health tiles
3. Is whitespace functional (margins, gutters) or wasteful (acres of blank)?
4. Verdict: `dense` | `acceptable` | `sparse` | `definitely-sparse`

### Output

```
docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json
```

Shape:
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "pages": {
    "index": {
      "verdict": "sparse",
      "thresholds_tripped": ["near_white_ratio", "data_fields"],
      "observations": "...",
      "missing": ["recent activity feed", "hot beads list"],
      "recommendations": ["..."]
    },
    ...
  }
}
```

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment on this bead: a verdict summary table (page → verdict → top recommendation).
- The full text of `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for downstream consumption.

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads for sparse pages
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every page in `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json` whose `verdict` ∈ {`sparse`, `definitely-sparse`}, file ONE bug bead with concrete redesign recommendations.

### Per-page bug bead

```bash
kd create "Info-density: <page> looks sparse — needs more signal/pixel" \
  --type=bug --project=gardenio -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:beads-viewer -l kind:info-density \
  --description "## Audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}
Verdict: <verdict>
Thresholds tripped: <list>

## Observations

<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Missing signal

- <bullet>
- <bullet>

## Recommended additions

- <bullet>
- <bullet>

## Evidence

- Screenshot: docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/<page>.png
- Metrics: docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json (this iteration)

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Deduplication rule

Before filing, search for an existing open bead with the same scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:info-density -l area:beads-viewer 2>&1 | grep -i "<page>"
```
If one exists for this page, comment the new evidence on the existing bead instead of filing a duplicate. Reference both iterations.

### Deliverables
- Comment on this bead listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID and which page it's for.
- If `verdicts.json` has zero sparse pages, comment 'No sparse pages this iteration — nothing to file.' and close the step.
- DO NOT close the parent epic; let the report step roll everything up first.

steps.title: Info-density audit ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and merge MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Produce a single rolled-up report on the parent epic and land the captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR (so future iterations can diff).

### Steps

1. Build the report markdown at `docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`:
   - Header: iteration, target URL, date.
   - Verdict matrix: 9-row table — page | verdict | near-white desktop | data fields | filed bug bead.
   - Inline embed: desktop screenshots for every `definitely-sparse` page.
   - Trends: if a previous iteration exists at `docs/info-density/<previous>/`, diff `near_white_ratio` and `data_fields` per page; flag deltas ≥ 0.05.
   - Index of bug beads filed/updated.

2. Commit the report:
   ```bash
   git add docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
   git commit -m "chore(info-density): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report"
   ```

3. Push and open MR:
   ```bash
   git push -u origin chore/info-density/{{ITERATION}}
   glab mr create \
     --title "chore(info-density): {{ITERATION}} audit" \
     --description "Automated info-density audit for {{TARGET_URL}}.\n\nReport: docs/info-density/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md\nParent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}" \
     --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge
   ```

4. Wait for CI green; if a transient flake occurs, retrigger the pipeline (NEVER close/reopen — see global advice on pipeline retriggers).

5. Self-merge once green (operator pre-authorized via global advice ka-0000002230 for gardenio repos).

6. Comment on parent epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}:
   ```
   Iteration {{ITERATION}} complete.
   Target: {{TARGET_URL}}
   Verdicts: <N>/9 dense or acceptable, <M>/9 sparse, <K>/9 definitely-sparse.
   Bug beads: <list of IDs>
   Report: <permalink to REPORT.md at merge SHA>
   ```

### Deliverables
- MR URL posted as comment on this step bead
- MR merged on main
- Comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}} with the rolled-up summary
- Close this step bead

This closes the molecule. The schedule trigger will fire the next iteration on its cadence.
